title: Monoidal adjunction for derived pullback across independent universes
statement: Let X and Y be schemes and f:X→Y [def-pc-scheme], and specify derived categories of their module sheaves in independent universes [def-pc-derived-category]. For the exact transported functor L=derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses f [def-pc-derived-pullback-across-universes] and R=schemeDerivedDirectImage f [def-pc-derived-direct-image], using the fixed K-flat derived tensor structures [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], there exists a CoreMonoidal structure m on L and an adjunction L⊣R. CoreMonoidal means coherent invertible tensor and unit comparison maps. No finiteness condition on f or perfect tensor argument is required.

source.place: Tags 079U (derived tensor comparison), 079W (unbounded derived adjunction), 06YJ (K-flat pullback); derived.tex, Tag 05RU (localization)

proof.text: In the standard localization take the canonical monoidal structure on derivedPullback supplied by exists_derivedPullbackMonoidalModel. The derived tensor structure is derived from the same sheaf tensor and K-flat resolutions. The uniqueness equivalences between localizations therefore carry coherent tensor and unit comparison isomorphisms: descend the comparisons on K-flat complexes by the localization universal property. Apply these comparisons to both equivalences in the definition of derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses, and compose the three strong monoidal structures.

Apply derivedModulePullback_adjunction to the underlying ringed-space morphism. Its module functor is the same tensor pullback used in derivedPullback: the object and morphism formulas identify the functors. The left-derived universal property identifies the standard derivedPullback with the left adjoint in that theorem. The right adjoint is the recorded schemeDerivedDirectImage by its definition. Transport the adjunction through the standard localization equivalences; uniqueness of the right-derived functor identifies the transported right side with the specified schemeDerivedDirectImage in the chosen target localization. Transport the unit and counit, and cancel the equivalence unit/counit in both triangle equations.

theorem exists_derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses_monoidal_adjunction
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] :
